newsitem.title: JORDAN: Jordan overnight rates in 9.25-9.50 pct range.
newsitem.headline: Jordan overnight rates in 9.25-9.50 pct range.

text.p: Overnight rates on the Jordanian dinar slipped slightly in a narrow 9.25-9.50 pct range on Tuesday after demand eased somewhat from Monday, dealers said.
Bankers and dealers said the bulk of deals were conducted at 9.25 percent against a 9.50-9.75 percent range on Monday.
A tight market has persisted since last week, with continued substantial fund transfers by state ministries to the Central Bank keeping the market short, dealers said.
